process.objective: Materialize reproducible, label-free owner calibration inputs so the Phase 1 benchmark can collect real product preference without reconstructing samples ad hoc or leaking process/source roles.

decisions.change: Created three owner-facing packets containing only neutral scenario text, Sample A/B prose, allowed preference results, and optional product-feedback prompts.
decisions.declared_reason: Iteration 02 had an owner calibration protocol but no concrete input surface, so preference collection would otherwise require manual reconstruction and risk metadata leakage.
decisions.expected_effect: Make owner labels collectable from frozen prose inputs without exposing internal source identities or intended winners.

decisions.change: Owner packets ask for overall A/B/TIE/UNCERTAIN first and make detailed feedback prompts optional rather than requiring full criterion scoring.
decisions.declared_reason: Owner preference is the primary personalized relevance signal; excessive rubric work would turn the owner into another benchmark worker and reduce practical calibration quality.
decisions.expected_effect: Keep human calibration lightweight while still allowing useful qualitative anchors when the difference is salient.

decisions.change: Separated reviewer-facing owner packets from an internal dispatch map that binds A/B positions back to calibration sample IDs and future judge reversal orders.
decisions.declared_reason: Traceability requires the mapping to exist, but Product/owner input must not carry source role or historical identity.
basis: Observable trace requirement for reproducible packet provenance
decisions.expected_effect: Preserve both reproducibility and preference isolation instead of sacrificing one for the other.

decisions.change: Updated owner calibration state to `READY_FOR_OWNER_LABELS` and linked each genuine pair to its materialized packet; the duplicate remains a judge-only reliability control.
decisions.declared_reason: The state should describe the inputs that actually exist and should not ask the owner to perform a meaningless preference judgment on identical text.
decisions.expected_effect: Create a clear next gate: collect real owner labels, then run independent counterbalanced judges.

implementation_steps.observed_result: No rubric, Writer, Truth, FoC, or production-scope changes were authorized.

implementation_steps.action: Read the three calibration source prose artifacts and materialized the three genuine owner pairs.
implementation_steps.observed_result: Each owner packet contains prose A/B and neutral preference prompts only; no source paths, internal sample IDs, FoC, process logs, or historical verdicts are included.

implementation_steps.action: Created a separate internal dispatch map for traceability and future judge A/B reversal.
implementation_steps.observed_result: Source identity and position-control mappings exist outside reviewer-facing packets.

implementation_steps.action: Linked materialized packets into the owner calibration state.
implementation_steps.observed_result: Three genuine pairs are READY_FOR_OWNER_LABELS; same-text duplicate remains judge-only.

measurement_design.primary_evaluation: Owner calibration can now consume three concrete opaque A/B prose packets and return overall A|B|TIE|UNCERTAIN without seeing source roles or craft references.
measurement_design.diagnostic_method: Optional owner comments capture attention drop, understanding change, memorable detail and preference reason; full rubric scoring is not required from the owner.
measurement_design.target_gap_method: No target-gap reference is present in owner packets; FoC remains isolated to Lane C after Product preference freeze.

dataset_partitions.calibration: Three genuine owner packets are materialized from the three calibration samples; internal A/B mapping is stored separately.
dataset_partitions.holdout: Unchanged fresh-exposed transfer sample, not blind/sequestered.

output.summary: The benchmark now has a concrete, reproducible human-calibration surface. Worker/process observability is preserved separately from owner-facing Product inputs. The next valid action is real owner preference labeling, not another rubric rewrite or a Writer round.
